title: Understanding the Code
text: The code snippet $$`exp\left(-\left(time_{of,day}-12\right)^2\right)`$$ is used to create a feature encoding based on the time of day. It uses the exponential function to model the likelihood of calls around a specific time.

title: Analyzing the Exponential Function
text: The expression $$`-\left(time_{of,day}-12\right)^2`$$ is inside the exponential function. This creates a bell-shaped curve centered around $$12$$, which represents noon.

title: Effect of Squaring the Difference
text: The term $$`\left(time_{of,day}-12\right)^2`$$ ensures that the values are symmetric around $$12$$. This means that times equally distant from noon will have the same feature encoding value.
